description:
Look up Japanese words, kanji, readings, meanings, conjugations, and example sentences in one focused dictionary.

Look up words in Japanese, English, or romaji, sorted by how common they are, and filter them to the words you know, are learning, or haven't marked yet. Open detailed entries with pitch accent and example sentences under their meanings, explore kanji components and stroke order, and hear Japanese pronunciation. Find a kanji you cannot type by handwriting, by its radicals, or by school grade. Mark words and kanji Learning or Known, save them to your own lists, and keep private notes and photos on them.

Translate a conversation as it happens. Two people take turns speaking Japanese or English, with no language button to press: each sentence appears as it's spoken with its translation underneath, and the translation is read aloud when the speaker pauses. Listening translates Japanese from a TV, a guide, or announcements, and you can also translate typed text, PDFs, and photos. Speech recognition and translation run on your iPhone, so after a one-time download Translate works without a connection. Tap any Japanese word to look it up, bookmark sentences to replay later, and see how many of a conversation's words you already know.

Watch YouTube videos with their Japanese captions as cards below the player. The line being spoken is highlighted as the video plays, and tapping a word pauses the video and opens it in the dictionary. See how much of a video's vocabulary you already know, repeat a line, or slow it down.

Photograph Japanese text, or pick up to 8 photos from your library, and read it as the photo, the photo with caption cards, the text alone, or a natural translation with notes on context and idioms. Tap any word to look it up, and keep image encounters with a word in your private Media Library.

Reading Aids can show furigana, a short meaning under each word you haven't marked known, and a translation under each line. Turn them on or off in Account, or from the menu of a word, a kanji, Example Sentences, or the Player.

Look up a word or translate text from Shortcuts, Siri, or Spotlight, or share a word, a sentence, or a photo to Zenbu from another app to see what it means without leaving that app.

Zenbu Japanese works without an account, and has no ads or analytics. Sign in with Apple, Google, or an emailed code for a free Zenbu account, and delete it from the app whenever you like. A Zenbu subscription, monthly or yearly, keeps your known and learning words, lists, notes, Media Library, settings, recent lookups, recent videos, and bookmarked sentences the same on all your devices; it renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple Account's settings. Everything else stays free. Your conversations stay on your iPhone, and the Player's video searches and playback go through YouTube.

whatsNew:
Zenbu Japanese 2.1 is a big update.

• Mark words and kanji Learning: they get a yellow tag and their own list in Account, keep their furigana and meanings, and sync.
• Known Words and Learning list your words as Look Up shows them, with their meanings, ranks, and tag.
• Show or hide furigana, word meanings, and translations from the ••• menu of a word, a kanji, Example Sentences, or the Player.
• A kanji in Look Up's results shows its own meanings.
• Search is now Look Up: sort results by a frequency dictionary or JLPT level, filter them to the words you know, are learning, or haven't marked, and find your notes too.
• Find kanji by school grade, beside Handwriting and Radicals.
• Meanings show the example sentence the dictionary pairs with them. Tap a meaning to hear it, copy it, or look it up.
• Look up and translate from Shortcuts, Siri, Spotlight, and other apps' share sheets.
• Image Search moved to Translate's Image, and opens up to 8 photos at once.
• Sync is now part of a Zenbu subscription, monthly or yearly, and keeps your notes, photos, settings, recent lookups, and profile photo the same on all your devices too. Subscribe from Zenbu Account. The dictionary, Translate, the Player, Image Search, and your Zenbu account stay free.
• Report a Problem from Account.
• More accurate pitch accents, romaji searches, and example sentences, and many more fixes.
promotionalText: Mark words Learning, show furigana from a word's menu, and find kanji by grade. Plus live conversation translation on your iPhone. Subscribe to sync your devices.
